name: interactive-story-platform
description: Storyframe — admin dashboard, public client site, Electron viewer and MongoDB-backed API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "node scripts/dev-web.mjs"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix admin install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix desktop install
scripts.test: cd shared && node --test test/*.test.js && cd ../server && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix admin --include=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build:admin && npm run build:client
